as_told.title: Thomas Townsend Brown's close encounters and space brothers

plain: The American inventor Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have talked often about being in contact with "space brothers", friendly aliens, and once claimed he was "communicating with aliens half the time." Michels brings this up himself on four episodes between 2025 and 2026. He tells it a little differently each time: once he credits the claim to a man named Agnew Bahnson, once he calls it experiences Brown described himself, and once he compares it to the film Close Encounters of the Third Kind.
